استنقذوا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْقَذُوا (istanqaḏū) /is.tan.qa.ðuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
# اُسْتُنْقِذُوا (ustunqiḏū) /us.tun.qi.ðuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
# اِسْتَنْقِذُوا (istanqiḏū) /is.tan.qi.ðuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَنْقَذَ (istanqaḏa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
